limitations: Integration correctness is not experimental predictive validity.
Rosetta interface analysis requires one protein binder and one protein target chain.
ipSAE interface contract supports one binder with an explicit target group; multiple binders are rejected.
Modified residues, explicit non-disulfide inter-residue bonds, explicit PDB CONECT topology, and structure-backed SMILES without verified atom/bond mapping are rejected.
CCD validation checks the installed identity and heavy-atom inventory, not stereochemistry, bond geometry, solvent effects, or affinity.
BindCraft2 and BoltzGen native GPU generation were not run; native ESMFold2 VHH generation and AbMPNN were exercised.
No complete three-generator VHH fan-in campaign was launched.
